motion: Social media platforms use sophisticated algorithms to deliberately manipulate user psychology and political beliefs for profit and control.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: Proponent A
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: Social media companies collect vast amounts of data on their users to manipulate content and keep them engaged.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: This statement revealed the extent of data collection and its connection to manipulation, influencing the audience's perception of social media platforms.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: Skeptic B
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: There is a growing body of research that suggests exposure to certain types of content can significantly impact users' beliefs and attitudes over time.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: This reference to research findings added credibility to the argument and swayed some audience members towards the skeptic's stance.

outcome_summary: The majority of participants changed their stance from neutral to skeptic after hearing key persuasion moments from both proponents and skeptics.
limitations: Limited sample size for the study
Variability in individual responses to persuasive tactics
